prompt_markdown: An AI tool wrote the pantry's ticket script. It runs, but one line uses a function you have never seen.
What is the best next step?
hint: An unfamiliar line needs an explanation you can check, not a guess or a delete.

options.text: Keep it, because the script runs.
Delete the line and hope nothing breaks.
Ask the tool what that line does and why it is needed, then check its answer in the official documentation.
Ask the tool to rewrite the whole script without explaining.

why: You ask for the reasoning and check it against an authoritative source, so the understanding stays with you.
